tests: 10 focused offline checks passed; stdout/stderr retained

findings.detail: Fsync is checked after messages; read stall can stretch the nominal five-second cadence to the read timeout. Each CSV row is flushed immediately; sudden power loss can lose un-fsynced tail.
Cutoff and STOP process closure can wait for existing read timeout up to about 12 seconds. Rows received at/after cutoff are rejected.

Storage errors are surfaced in the shared reconnect/error path rather than a distinct disk failure state. Journal/checkpoint failures may terminate process; scheduled checks detect absent or stale writer.
writer.lock is not explicitly closed by main; function-scope CPython lifetime/OS process exit releases it; tests issue ResourceWarnings. Exclusive lock exclusion test passed.
